notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just letting you know that I've recently updated this visual novel!
The newest build should fix a handful of spelling/grammatical errors that were present in the old script.

If you find more spelling errors in this build, or encounter any other technical problems, please let me know!

- ebi x

notes.title: A Winter's Daydream released on Steam!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I thought I'd let you know that my latest visual novel, A Winter's Daydream, has been released on Steam!
A Winter's Daydream is a cute story about an elderly grandmother who magically transforms into a young girl! Wacky anime hijinks ensue.

Like AIdol, A Winter's Daydream is a relatively light-hearted, relaxing story with some comedy scenes. If you enjoyed one, you might enjoy the other!

The story can be found here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/925340/A_Winters_Daydream/

- ebi x
